scope: Complete author reading of the current changelog, gap-analysis and release pages, the public roadmap and roadmap index, both released stability contracts, and all three historical-note entry pages. Historical release narratives were assessed as dated records rather than current setup instructions. This review verifies page truth and installed-wheel version-check behavior; it does not approve the candidate, recertify every historical API, or run deployment and release workflows.

reviews.reason: The introduction routes readers to current guidance and the v0.7/v0.6 release entries preserve bounded contracts. Historical APIs remain historical; the footer now links this repository's release page.

The nine-category sequential scanner, failure behavior and CLI/API surface match source. The page now states that its implemented Python threshold accepts 3.10 even though package metadata requires 3.11 or newer.
Separates candidate evidence and exact-ref hosted gates from manually authorized publication and names the current compatibility, PostgreSQL, package and reference-application checks.
Labels both v0.5.49 notes as dated records and directs readers to the current manual and v0.7 contract.
The direct-entry banner prevents old security and release claims from being used as current instructions while preserving the original record.
The direct-entry banner links current security, stability and production guidance; the dated design narrative remains intact.
The roadmap distinguishes released v0.7.0, in-progress v0.7.1, a conditional v0.8 thesis, later/explore/non-goal horizons and bounded 1.0 criteria. Its detailed review link now targets main.
Provides a short hub for the current roadmap and both release contracts without duplicated contract wording.
Preserves the historical stable and experimental v0.6 boundary while naming the actual run_prompt_pack and AgentRuntimeLimits/AgentRuntimeBudget surfaces instead of a nonexistent AgentRuntime class.
Defines the authoritative v0.7 Operation guarantees, production profile, task/MCP compatibility and explicit external, workflow and persistence limits.

contradictions.boundary: Live roadmap and changelog navigation linked a temporary feature branch and an unrelated nonexistent GitHub release repository.
contradictions.disposition: The roadmap report link now targets main and the changelog footer targets nagarjuna-tella/Aksara releases.

contradictions.boundary: Gap Analysis presented its Python 3.10 threshold without warning that current package metadata and the supported matrix require Python 3.11 or newer.
contradictions.disposition: The guide identifies GAP001, states the implemented threshold exactly and makes package metadata/runtime compatibility authoritative.

contradictions.boundary: The v0.6 contract called a nonexistent AgentRuntime class a usable experimental surface.
contradictions.disposition: The historical contract now names run_prompt_pack plus the actual AgentRuntimeLimits and AgentRuntimeBudget types.
